treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Republic of Bulgaria for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance (2020)
eif_quote: De bepalingen van het Verdrag, met Protocol, zijn ingevolge artikel 30, eerste lid, van het Verdrag op 31 juli 2021 in werking getreden, met inachtneming van het gestelde in artikel 30, tweede tot en met vierde lid, van het Verdrag.
source_title: wetten.overheid.nl consolidated text BWBV0006879 (English authentic text; NL/BG/EN equally authentic, English prevails)

rates.quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2, dividends referred to in paragraph 1 shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is: a) a company (other than a partnership) which is a resident of the other Contracting State and holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividend

However, dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State may also be taxed in that State according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Replaces the 1990 NL-BG Convention (Art. 30(3)). Art. 30(2)(a): taxes withheld at source apply to amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2021-07-31 -> 2022-01-01). Dividend exemption (Art. 10(3)) also for pension funds (10(3)(b)); not applicable to hidden profit distributions (Art. 10(5)); Protocol II: Art. 10(3)(a) not for Dutch FBI; Dutch VBI not entitled to Art. 10-13/21 benefits. Interest taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(3)) where recipient is a State/subdivision/local authority/public body/central bank, state-supported loans, Atradius DSB/FMO, pension funds, loans granted by a bank or insurance company, and sales on credit of equipment or merchandise between enterprises - not modelled. Art. 23(4)-(6): third-state PE (60%) anti-abuse rule. Not an MLI covered tax agreement (neither State lists it); PPT is in the treaty (Art. 23(1)).
